_about: Governed-data-seam pattern. Agents reach data through a named MCP server, never raw credentials. Point each server at ONE source, expose ONLY the tools that source needs, and keep secrets in env vars — not in this file. Copy an entry, rename it, fill in your source. Your mileage may vary.

data-warehouse._note: Example governed read seam. Swap the command/args for your source: BigQuery, Spanner, AlloyDB, or Cloud SQL. Credentials come from the environment, never hardcoded.

_exampleSources.bigquery: read-only analytics queries over a warehouse dataset

official-docs._note: Example live-documentation seam. Agents fetch current official docs instead of relying on memory. Point each server at ONE vendor's official docs MCP; verify the package name and currency before pinning — this space moves fast (snapshot 2026-07).

_exampleDocsServers.azure: Azure MCP Server — github.com/microsoft/mcp (verify current package)
_exampleDocsServers.google-cloud: Google managed remote MCP servers — verify the current service list
